artworks.title: Thomas, First Baron Coventry
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated upright, facing the viewer with a direct gaze. The man has an oval face, a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and wears a high-crowned hat. He is dressed in elaborate attire of the period, including a high, ruffled lace collar and a patterned doublet. One of his hands rests on a large, circular seal or medallion. The background features an ornate frame with scrollwork, inscriptions, and an emblem at the top. Latin inscriptions are present on the frame. The overall color scheme consists of muted grays and blacks.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man seated and leaning slightly forward. His face is turned towards the viewer, revealing distinct facial features including a moustache and a beard. His eyes are prominent and he has curly hair that is partially covered by a tall, brimmed hat with a decorative band. His attire is elaborate, featuring a broad, ornate ruff collar and a richly detailed doublet with patterned sleeves. Around his shoulders, he wears a patterned cape or coat. His hands are visible at the bottom of the image, with one resting on a surface. The man is enclosed within an oval frame. In the background, parallel lines create a textured effect. Beneath the image, there's a section of text that pays tribute to the man.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man viewed from the waist up within an ornate frame resembling a window or arch. The man faces forward, with his body slightly turned to the right. He has distinctive facial features, including a nose, jawline, mustache, and short beard. His hair is wavy and swept back, partly covering his ears. He wears elaborate clothing with a high ruffled collar and a textured garment with intricate patterns. A coat of arms is displayed on his chest. His left hand rests on a shield or emblem with ornate designs and possible inscriptions. The background features an etched design with additional decorative elements around the portrait frame. A ribbon-like scroll borders the portrait with inscribed text and embellishments, including crown and scepter motifs at the top.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Bacon
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He faces the viewer with a serious expression, holding a closed book in his left hand. The man has a beard, mustache, and mid-length wavy hair. He wears formal attire including a richly patterned doublet, a lace ruff around his neck, and a draped cape over his right shoulder. The man is enclosed in an oval frame with heraldic emblems, decorative scrolls, and text. The setting around the portrait is elaborate, and there is an inscription in French below the image referencing the artwork and the name "Bacon."

artworks.title: William Knollis, Earl of Banbury, When Viscount Wallingford
artworks.description: The image depicts an upper-body engraving of a man sitting upright, dressed in elaborate 16th or early 17th-century attire. He has a distinguished face with a full beard and moustache, beneath what appears to be a wide-brimmed, tall hat. His hair appears to be short, styled neatly. He is wearing a richly textured robe with intricate patterns, and a large, ornate ruffed collar encircles his neck. The sleeves of his robe are detailed with decorative designs. He holds a rolled paper or document in one hand. Around his neck, he wears a medallion on a ribbon. The background is intricately designed, featuring scrolling floral patterns and a coat of arms at the top. Decorative banners with text surround the figure.

artworks.title: William Knollis, Earl of Banbury, When Viscount Wallingford
artworks.description: The image shows a man in an upright pose, wearing a dark hat, fur-trimmed cloak with embroidery, ruffled shirt, and holding a folded paper or book in his right hand. He has a pointed beard and mustache, a composed expression, and a medallion on his chest. The background is decorated with ornate scrolls, a crest with a shield and crown, inscriptions, and elaborate designs.

artworks.title: Lucia Harrington, Countess of Bedford
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up, seated slightly turned to her right but facing forward, enclosed in an ornate oval frame. The woman has an oval face, large almond-shaped eyes, and delicate lips. Her hair is styled in a curly manner with a feather accessory. She is wearing a dark gown with intricate patterns, a high lace collar, and lace-trimmed sleeves. Her hands rest in front of her, with a ring visible on one finger. The frame is held by two winged cherubs, with a crest at the top. The background is filled with engraved patterns. Below the portrait is a scroll with engraved text.

artworks.title: Lucia Harrington, Countess of Bedford
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a woman seated within a decorative oval frame, with her hands resting at the bottom edge. Her face is forward-facing with arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, a delicate nose, and slightly parted lips. Her hair is styled elaborately with curls framing her face and intricate styling at the top. She wears a high lace collar and an ornate dress with detailed patterns, including a brocade-like texture and lace cuffs, along with dangling earrings. Two cherubic figures with wings holding banners or ribbons float above the frame, and a coat of arms is displayed above her. The background features dense cross-hatching. The oval frame's border contains inscribed Latin words, and poetic text is seen at the lower portion of the image with swirling, cloud-like decorations.

artworks.title: Lucia Harrington, Countess of Bedford
artworks.description: This image is an engraved portrait of a person shown from the waist up. The individual is positioned facing slightly towards the left, gazing directly at the viewer. The person's facial features are finely detailed, with arched eyebrows, expressive eyes, a prominent nose, and slightly pursed lips, framed by an elaborate hairstyle characterized by tight curls and adorned with a small tiara-like headpiece. The attire is ornate and intricately designed, featuring a high lace ruff collar and elaborately patterned fabric, indicative of aristocratic fashion. The sleeves of the dress are adorned with lace cuffs and embroidery. The person is shown holding a circular frame, around which the text "LUCIA HARRT COM: BEDFORDIÆ NOBILISSIMA & PRUDENT: DO" encircles them. The background is densely filled with intricate scrollwork and text, and above the head, two angels are depicted holding a decorated shield.

artworks.title: Anne Bill
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a portrait of a woman in an oval frame, displaying her head and upper chest. She has a composed expression, with delicate facial features and a lace-framed cap covering her hair. She is wearing an Elizabethan-style dress with an intricate lace collar around her neck and a pendant necklace. Above her portrait, an angel with wings is depicted resting its head on its hand, surrounded by architectural motifs and clouds with Latin text. The background features a pastoral landscape with trees and hills, visible on either side of the central architectural structure framing the portrait.

artworks.title: Anne Bill
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a woman in a portrait, shown from the shoulders up within an oval frame. The woman has a calm expression, detailed eyes, a slightly downturned mouth, and a prominent nose. She wears a high-collared dress with lace trim and a lace-edged cap. Above the frame is an angelic figure with wings and curly hair, resting hands on top of the frame, looking downwards. Decorative elements above include clouds, books, and musical instruments. The background features trees and a distant landscape. The lower part of the image contains ornate text detailing the dedication of the artwork.

artworks.title: Anne Bill
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait set within an ornate architectural structure. A bust of a woman is depicted within a circular frame or medallion, capturing her from the shoulders up. She has a calm expression with delicate facial features; her eyes look forward under a headpiece that fits closely around her head. Lace or decorative fabric lines the edge of this headpiece, and her hair is covered. Her clothing includes a high-collar garment, and there is a glimpse of a decorative piece, possibly lace, at her neck. Above the medallion, an angelic figure with wavy hair and downcast eyes leans over, hands resting near the edges of the frame. The angel's wings are visible beside its shoulders, and it wears flowing robes. Behind the angel, books and musical instruments sit atop the structure, accompanied by a billowing cloud with the name "ANNA" and a Latin inscription. To either side of the portrait, intricately carved pillars and designs frame the scene. The background reveals a bucolic landscape with trees, a distant church, and open sky.

artworks.title: Anne Bill
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a memorial scene with two main figures. The central element is an oval portrait encased in an elaborate frame on a pedestal. The portrait displays the bust of a woman with a headdress. Behind the portrait, an angel figure with wings is depicted from the waist up, leaning forward. The angel has curly hair and a contemplative expression. The angel's right hand is gesturing towards the portrait, while the left hand rests beside it. Above the angel, a cloud with inscriptions and an open book surrounded by various objects like a quill pen are visible. The background includes architectural elements, patterns, and distant landscapes featuring a small building and foliage. Another angelic figure is on the left side holding the frame of the portrait. Latin inscriptions are present below the portrait, with decorative motifs surrounding the scene.

artworks.title: Anne Bill
artworks.description: The image shows a half-length portrait of a woman depicted in the form of a bust within an oval frame. The woman is positioned centrally, facing directly forward. Her facial features include closed eyes and a calm expression, and her hair is covered with a cap adorned with lace. Around her, she wears a dark drape and under it, a dress with a high lace collar. Above the portrait, an angel with wings is positioned, looking down towards the oval frame, and a hand is resting on top of the frame. The angel's hair is curly and flows to the shoulders. The setting includes a large, decorative architectural element resembling a pedestal or monument supporting the frame. Above this, an opened book with a quill and some sort of horn rest over it. The background features a scene with clouds and appears to depict a landscape with trees and hills extending into the distance. Latin inscriptions are present around the image, providing textual context.

artworks.title: Thomas Egerton, First Viscount of Brackley
artworks.description: The image shows an illustrated portrait of a man. He is depicted from the upper half of his body, with his right hand holding a scroll or paper. The man has an older appearance with a beard, mustache, and neat short hair. He is dressed in ornate clothing, including a decorative collar and a richly embellished robe. A chain is visible around his neck. The background features swirls and patterns, and an oval frame surrounds the figure. Inscriptions are present around the edge of the frame. Below the portrait, there is a block of text providing context.

artworks.title: Thomas Egerton, First Viscount of Brackley
artworks.description: The image is an oval portrait engraving of a man named Thomas Egerton. He is depicted seated, facing slightly to his right but looking at the viewer. He has a high forehead, a short beard, mustache, and short, combed-back hair. He wears elaborate clothing with a large lace collar, a richly decorated coat with embroidery, and a chain with a pendant. His right hand is visible, holding a document or paper. The background inside the oval is plain with etched lines, while the outside contains ornate scrollwork and Latin text.

artworks.title: Christian, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's upper body. He is looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile, wearing a large hat and period-style outfit. The man has medium-length hair peeking out from under the hat and is holding the hilt of a sword on his right side. The background shows even horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Christian, Duke of Brunswick
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving with multiple sections. In the center is the bust of Christiaen Hertoch tot Brunswyck, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and intricate clothing with a high lace collar. Flanking him are two full-length figures holding flags with inscriptions. The background and borders are ornate with scrollwork and combat scenes. The top and bottom sections show vignettes of swordplay and a dramatic scene around a drum, with figures in period clothing.

artworks.title: George Villiers, First Duke of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image depicts an elegantly dressed man from the knees up. He faces slightly to the right, with one hand on his chest and the other holding a staff or baton. His face is turned towards the viewer with a neatly trimmed beard and mustache, curly light-colored hair, a high-status outfit with a richly decorated doublet, intricate lace cuffs, a high lace collar, a draped cloak over his left shoulder, and a heavy chain around his neck. The ornate portrait is bordered by an oval frame with decorative elements. The background shows a curtain on the left and a detailed scroll with text, symbols, and figures in the lower half.

artworks.title: George Villiers, First Duke of Buckingham
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man standing in a slightly angled position, facing towards the viewer's right. He has well-defined facial features with a mustache and a beard, and medium-length curly hair. He is wearing an ornate garment with lace cuffs and a detailed pattern, holding a large sash or cloak over one shoulder. The man has one hand resting on a stack of books or pedestal, and is wearing a ruffled collar around his neck. In one hand, he holds what appears to be a jewel or ornate clasp. The background features a tall column, and the portrait is enclosed in a decorative frame with floral and horn motifs, as well as classical figures playing musical instruments at the base. An inscription surrounds the portrait within the frame.

artworks.title: James Hay, First Earl of Carlisle
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, with a high forehead, neatly trimmed beard and mustache, curly hair styled in a manner common for the early 17th century, and wearing a decorated garment, possibly a doublet, with intricate patterns and a lace ruff around his neck. He has a bracelet or cuff on his left wrist, his right hand holds a stick, and his left hand rests on his chest. The frame around the portrait contains text and a coat of arms at the top with two figures and a shield with a cross. The background has a textured shading for depth.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England as Duke of York
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person depicted from the waist up. The person is facing forward with a slight turn to their left side. They have a youthful appearance with smooth facial features, including closely aligned eyes, a small nose, and a closed mouth. Their hair is short and neatly combed back away from their forehead. The individual is wearing elaborate attire that includes a richly adorned garment with a high, intricate lace collar and a sash. There is also a pendant hanging from a chain around their neck. In the background, the portrait is enclosed in an ornate circular design with text surrounding it, and the inside of the circle features a finely textured pattern.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England, as Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a person. The individual is depicted from the upper body, slightly turned to the right. They have a young face with delicate features, styled hair, and wear a garment with a high lace ruff around the neck. The clothing includes ornate armor. The background features an oval frame with Latin inscription, and a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England, as Duke of York
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait depicting the upper body of a seated individual facing slightly to their left. The person has distinctive facial features with closed lips, a nose, and eyes looking directly at the viewer. They have upward styled hair with slight curls at the sides. The person is wearing an elaborate outfit that includes a detailed ruffled collar, a patterned doublet with vertical decorations, and ornate sleeves. There are no visible accessories or objects. An oval border surrounds the portrait with Latin text, and on either side, there are male and female figures holding staffs. The background is textured, contrasting with the smooth depiction of the person within the circular frame.
